items.Sentence: Raw wastewater or influent enters at the headworks where it passes through a comminutor (grinder)
prior to being discharged to an unlined complete-mix aerated lagoon
effluent is discharged to one of six unlined oxidation lagoons, where the effluent percolates into the underlying soil/substrate and evaporates
Effluent in excess of what the ponds can hold is discharged to about 32 acres of adjacent pasture land
